name: Authenticated Wager Save & Remote Sync Recovery V1

rootCauses.invalidStake: Draft parsing used scattered raw Number() calls instead of one canonical input policy; Release 14A aligns validation, payout, risk and save payload around canonical stake parsing.
rootCauses.unavailablePayoutRisk: Payout and max-loss calculations depended on raw draft strings and returned null/Unavailable when odds or stake were not parsed into canonical numeric values.
rootCauses.remoteLedgerSyncFailure: Production ledger tables existed, but Supabase REST returned PGRST205, indicating schema-cache/role exposure was unavailable for user_wagers and user_wager_legs.

productionMigrationEvidence.applyBlocker: No Supabase CLI or direct database URL is available in this execution environment.
